bondInfo.name: Ursus
bondInfo.desc: [Ursus] Operators gain +(35 + 0.75 x stacks)% ATK and +(10 + 0.3 x stacks)% HP. When [Ursus] Operators defeat an enemy, +2 temporary stacks to [Ursus] alliance. <With 6 different [Ursus] Operators on field> (15 + 0.05 x stacks)% of damage taken by [Ursus] ops is converted to a bleed effect over 10 seconds; HP bleed effect will stop when the damage source is defeated. When blocking enemies, enemies take (50 + 0.25 x stacks)% of the blocker's ATK as Arts damage every second. The amount of temporary [Ursus] stacks gained increases to 4.

bondInfo.name: Iberia
bondInfo.desc: When [Iberia] Operators or Alchemical Units deal damage, the enemy takes additional Arts damage every second equal to (11 + 0.06 x stacks)% of ATK for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. <With 6 different [Iberia] Operators on field> The DoT effect is doubled, and reduces the enemy's move speed by 4% (stacking up to 80%). When [Iberia] Operators or Alchemical Units deal damage, there is a chance to deal Arts damage equals to 300% ATK to nearby enemies.

bondInfo.name: Leithanien
bondInfo.desc: [Leithanien] Operators and summons gain +(30 + 1 x stacks)% ATK. When an enemy is defeated, summon a "Section" on that tile (up to 10 on field). <With 6 different [Leithanien] Operators on field> There is a (30 + 1 x stacks)% chance to summon a "Band" instead of a "Section" . While a "Band" is present on field, [Leithanien] Operators gain +20 ASPD, and increase the "Section" limit to 20. When an ally is defeated, summon a "Band" at their place.

bondInfo.name: Yan
bondInfo.desc: [Yan] Operators gain +(23 + 0.9 × stacks)% ATK <With 6 different [Yan] Operators on field> [Yan] Operators' attacks inflict 6% ATK as Elemental Injury of a random type. All enemies have their Elemental Injury rcovery rate increased by (40 + 0.3 x stacks)%.

bondInfo.name: Sargon
bondInfo.desc: When any [Sargon] Operator activates a skill, all [Sargon] Operators temporarily gain +12 ASPD (up to +300) for (5 + 0.22 x stacks) seconds. <With 6 different [Yan] Operators on field> When any [Sargon] Operator activates a skill, they create a quicksand area within their attack range. Enemies inside quicksand have their movement speed reduced by (20 + 0.025 x stacks)%, take (5000 + 25 x stacks) Arts damage per second and are Bound for 1 second. While a [Sargon] Operator's skill is active, the quicksand's slowing effect is doubled, and deals (800 + 4 x stacks) Arts damage per second.

bondInfo.name: Victoria
bondInfo.desc: [Victoria] Operators carrying equipment deal (125 + 0.8 x stacks)% damage. <Every 25 stacks> Obtain 1 random Victorian Hammer <With 6 different [Victoria] Operators on field> All [Victoria] Operators gain +40% ATK for each piece of equipment; +80% ATK if equipment is upgraded*

bondInfo.name: Kjerag
bondInfo.desc: [Kjerag] Operators deal 125% damage, and deal (135 + 1 x stacks)% damage to Cold and Frozen enemies <Every 100 stacks> Obtain 1 'Kjeragi Nevermeltice" <With 6 different [Kjerag] Operators on field> At the start of battle, summon a Snow Mountain Giant that acts independently (ATK and HP affected by stacks). The Snow Mountain Giant will switch between Snow Mountain and Giant forms. Snow Mountain Form: Can block enemies and deal splash damage, deals high Arts damage to Frozen enemies and removes the Frozen status. Giant Form: Can move and deals ranged splash damage to enemies.

bondInfo.name: Ægir
bondInfo.desc: [Ægir] Operators +(35 + 1 x stacks)% HP When the battle begins, [Ægir] Operators will devour the Operator on the tile in front of them, dealing 5000 Physical damage to the Operator and gaining their base ATK and Block, while adding [Ægir] stacks equal to the devoured Operator's Tier (among [Ægir] Operators, those positioned further up or to the left are prioritised to start a devour) <With 6 different [Ægir] Operators on the field> The first 3 defeated will immediately revive

bondInfo.name: Siracusa
bondInfo.desc: [Siracusa] Operators gain +(25 + 0.8 x stacks) ASPD on deployment for (32 + 0.4 x stacks) seconds <With 6 different Siracusa Operators on the field> Each attack has a chance to randomly inflict one Negative Status on an enemy for a certain duration (affected by stacks); when an enemy has 2 or more Negative Status, they deal true damage to themselves and surrounding enemies once per second (affected by stacks).

bondInfo.name: Kazimierz
bondInfo.desc: On every Operator deployment, [Kazimierz] Operators gain +20% ATK (up to +(50 + 1 x stacks)%). <With 6 [Kazimierz] Operators on the field> When [Kazimierz] Operators is defeated, they will leave the field, and the [Kazimierz] operator on the rightmost slot of the support area is deployed to the field (does not affect alliance active status); [Kazimierz] Operators deal an additional 65% ATK as True damage for 30 seconds after deployment or when their skill is active.

bondInfo.name: Aggregation
bondInfo.desc: Operators in the range of [Aggregation] Operators recover HP equals (16 + 0.12 x stacks)% and Elemental Injury equals to (8 + 0.06 x stacks)% of the [Aggregation] Operator's ATK . <With 3 [Aggregation] Operators on field> All Operators in range of [Aggregation] Operators gain (15 + 0.08 x stacks)% Sanctuary.

bondInfo.name: Investor
bondInfo.desc: Operators' 'When obtained' Attributes trigger twice <At 100 stacks> 'When obtained' Attributes trigger 3 times instead

bondInfo.name: Harmony
bondInfo.desc: When activated, +1 Operator count to Core Alliances ([Yan], [Sargon], [Victoria], [Kjerag], [Ursus], [Iberia], [Leithanien], [Ægir], [Siracusa] and [Kazimierz]); [Harmony] Operators also gain effects from said activated Alliances

bondInfo.name: Foresight
bondInfo.desc: <For every 10 stacks added> Gain +2 Funds <At 80 stacks (first-time only)> [Foresight] Operators cost 1 less Fund permanently <At 150 stacks (first-time only)> [Foresight] Operators cost an additional 1 less Fund permanently [Foresight] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance

bondInfo.name: Precision
bondInfo.desc: [Precision] Operators +(10 + 1.2 x stacks)% ATK <With 3 different [Precision] Operators on field> Buff affects all [Precision] and Ranged Operators, and attacks ignore 30% DEF and RES

bondInfo.name: Durable
bondInfo.desc: All Operators gain +(25 + 1.2 x stacks)% HP <With 3 different [Durable] Operators on the field> Whenever a non-[Durable] Operator takes damage, 40% of that damage is split among all [Durable] Operators on field. Durable Operators taking damage inflicts (850 + 10 x stacks)% Arts damage (once every 0.2 seconds) and 40% Fragile to the attacker

bondInfo.name: Raid
bondInfo.desc: If a [Raid] Operator's skill is ready or has not attacked for 10 seconds, and has no enemies in their attack range, they will redeploy near a ground enemy, use their skill without losing SP, and gain +(25 + 1 × stacks)% ATK and HP <At 50 stacks> All Operators +50 ATKSPD

bondInfo.name: Marvel
bondInfo.desc: On Dispatch Center refresh, there is a (18 + 0.25 x stacks)% chance the next refresh will be free <At 100 stacks (first-time only)> When refreshing the Dispatch Center, at least one Operator with tier equal to the Dispatch Center level will appear [Marvel] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance

bondInfo.name: Resilient
bondInfo.desc: When a Ground Operator is defeated, there is a (18 + 0.4 x stacks)% chance they will immediately redeploy <With 3 different [Resilient] Operators on field> When defeated, Ground Operators grant +5 SP to all Operators on the field

bondInfo.name: Swift
bondInfo.desc: [Swift] Operators have a (20 + 0.35 x stacks)% chance when their skill ends to immediately recover 12 SP <At 40 stacks> All Operators have the same chance to recover 15 SP when their skill ends

bondInfo.name: Aid
bondInfo.desc: All Operators gain +(15 + 1.2 x stacks)% DEF and -30% Redeployment Time When Rest Phase ends, +2 stacks to all active Alliances <With 3 different [Aid] Operators on field> +4 stacks instead

bondInfo.name: Agile
bondInfo.desc: [Agile] Operators and Operators in the 4 adjacent tiles around them gain +(10 + 1 x stacks) ASPD <At 40 stacks> Effect range increased to 8 tiles surrounding [Agile] Operators

bondInfo.name: Arcane
bondInfo.desc: When [Arcane] Operators deal damage, deal an additional instance of Arts damage equal to (20 + 0.4 x stacks)% ATK <With 3 different [Arcane] Operators on field> All enemies on field have -1 RES every time they take damage (up to (-30 - 0.05 x stacks)); Enemies lose Invisibility when entering [Arcane] Operators' ranges.

bondInfo.name: Solo
bondInfo.desc: <With 1 [Solo] Operator on field> The [Solo] Operator gains +60% ATK and HP, and +15 SP on deployment. Effect disabled with 2 or more different [Solo] Operators on the field

bondInfo.name: Assist_Operator
bondInfo.desc: All Operators take -20% Physical and Arts damage [Assist Operators] deal 120% more damage; Elite [Assist Operators] deal 140% more damage

bondInfo.name: Elite
bondInfo.desc: <With 2 Elite Operators on field> Elite Operators +30% ATK <With 5 Elite Operators on field> Elite Operators -30% SP cost All Elite Operators can activate this Alliance
